    AI Overview
    Yes,
    Publix stores are closed on Easter Sunday. All Publix locations, pharmacies, and liquor stores close annually on Easter to allow associates to spend time with family. Stores are open for normal hours on Saturday, April 4, 2026, but will remain closed on Sunday, April 5, 2026. 
    Key Holiday Info: 
    • Closed Dates: Easter, Thanksgiving, and Christmas.
    • Alternatives: Other stores, such as Walmart, Kroger, and Trader Joe's, are typically open on Easter, though often with reduced hours.
    • Pharmacies: Publix pharmacies are closed on Easter Sunday. 
    It is recommended to do your shopping on Saturday, April 4, 2026, as all locations will be closed on Sunday. 
    Further Exploration:

    • Read a more detailed, local perspective on the closures from the Sarasota Herald-Tribune via AOL.
    • Find out which of your local stores are closed on Fayetteville Today.

    Yes,
    all Publix stores, pharmacies, and liquor stores are closed on Easter Sunday, April 5, 2026. Easter is one of only three holidays (along with Thanksgiving and Christmas) that Publix closes all locations to allow employees time with family. Stores will be open for normal hours on Saturday, April 4. 
    Where to shop on Easter Sunday:
    If you need last-minute items, these stores are generally open on Easter: 
    • Walmart (regular hours)
    • Walgreens & CVS
    • Winn-Dixie
    • Whole Foods Market
    • Trader Joe's
    • Sprouts Farmers Market
    • Dollar General & Dollar Tree 
    Closed on Easter: 
    • Aldi
    • Costco Wholesale
    • Sam's Club
    • Target
